TLS 1.3 handshake API for QUIC with Ed25519, X25519, and AES-128-GCM support.

# Purpose
Defines the public interface for `fd_tls`, a TLS v1.3 handshake implementation used for peer-to-peer QUIC connections in the Solana network protocol. It declares callback types for randomness, message output, secret delivery, QUIC transport parameters, and Ed25519 signing, and it stores the local TLS configuration in `fd_tls_t`. The file also defines handshake state values, encryption levels, size limits, and extended alert reason codes used to report handshake errors. Public functions provide object lifecycle control, client and server handshake processing, alert and reason string lookup, and the TLS 1.3 `HKDF-Expand-Label` helper.
